architecture.mechanism: Two-parameter lateral velocity model capturing lateral dynamics during low-speed parking
architecture.intervention: Integrate the two-parameter lateral velocity model into the transmission control unit software to refine wheel speed interpretation and prevent false park-disengage signals caused by lateral slip during stationary or low-speed maneuvers.
architecture.expected_effect: Improved distinction between actual vehicle movement and sensor noise induced by lateral slip, ensuring the parking pawl remains engaged when intended and preventing unintended vehicle movement.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject a 2020 Kia Forte to controlled low-speed lateral slip tests on a low-friction surface while in park; if the transmission disengages or reports motion inconsistent with the new model's predictions, the mechanism fails.
